an10.89:1.1: Atha kho Kokāliko bhikkhu yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Kokāliko bhikkhu Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an10.89:1.2: ‘pāpicchā bhante Sāriputta-Moggallānā pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃ gatā' ti.
an10.89:1.3: ‘Mā h' evaṃ Kokālika, mā h' evaṃ Kokālika,
an10.89:2.1: Dutiyam pi kho Kokāliko bhikkhu Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an10.89:2.2: ‘kiñcāpi me bhante Bhagavā saddhāyiko paccayiko, atha kho pāpicchā' va Sāriputta-Moggallānā pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃ gatā' ti.
an10.89:2.3: ‘Mā h' evaṃ Kokālika, mā h' evaṃ Kokālika,
an10.89:3.1: Tatiyam pi kho Kokāliko bhikkhu Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca ‘ . . .
an10.89:4.1: Atha kho Kokāliko bhikkhu uṭṭhāyāsanā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
an10.89:4.2: Acirapakkantassa ca Kokālikassa bhikkhuno sāsapamattīhi piḷakāhi sabbo kāyo phuṭo ahosi.
an10.89:4.3: Sāsapamattiyo hutvā muggamattiyo ahesuṃ, muggamattiyo hutvā kalāyamattiyo ahesuṃ. Kalāyamattiyo hutvā kolaṭṭhimattiyo ahesuṃ. Kolaṭṭhimattiyo hutvā kolamattiyo ahesuṃ. Kolamattiyo hutvā āmalakamattiyo ahesuṃ. Āmalakamattiyo hutvā beluvasalāṭukamattiyo ahesuṃ. Beluvasalāṭukamattiyo hutvā billamattiyo ahesuṃ. Billamattiyo hutvā pabhijjiṃsu. Pubbañ ca lohitañ ca pagghariṃsu.
an10.89:4.4: Svāssudaṃ kadalipattesu seti maccho va visagilito. 3.
an10.89:5.1: Atha kho Tuduppaccekabrahmā yena Kokāliko bhikkhu ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā vehāse ṭhatvā Kokālikaṃ bhikkhuṃ etad avoca
an10.89:5.6: ‘Nanu tvaṃ āvuso Bhagavatā anāgāmī vyākato, atha kiñcarahi idhāgato,
an10.89:5.7: passa yāva te idaṃ aparaddhan' ti.
an10.89:6.1: Atha kho Tuduppaccekabrahmā Kokālikaṃ bhikkhuṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi:
an10.89:10.4: vācaṃ manañ ca paṇidhāya pāpakan ti. 4.
an10.89:11.1: Atha kho Kokāliko bhikkhu ten' evābādhena kālam akāsi.
an10.89:11.2: Kālakato ca Kokāliko bhikkhu padumanirayaṃ upapajjati Sāriputta-Moggallānesu cittaṃ āghātetvā.
an10.89:12.1: Atha kho Brahmā Sahampati abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ Jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho Brahmā Sahampati Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an10.89:12.3: kālakato ca bhante Kokāliko bhikkhu padumanirayaṃ upapanno Sāriputta-Moggallānesu cittaṃ āghātetvā' ti.
an10.89:12.5: idaṃ vatvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatth' ev' antaradhāyi. 5.
an10.89:13.1: Atha kho Bhagavā tassā rattiyā accayena bhikkhū āmantesi:
an10.89:13.2: Imaṃ bhikkhave rattiṃ Brahmā Sahampati abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ Jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yenāhaṃ ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho bhikkhave Brahmā Sahampati maṃ etad avoca
an10.89:13.4: kālakato ca bhante Kokāliko bhikkhu padumanirayaṃ upapanno SāriputtaMoggallānesu cittaṃ āghātetvā' ti.
an10.89:13.6: idaṃ vatvā maṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatth' ev' antaradhāyī ti. 6.
an10.89:14.1: Evam vutte aññataro bhikkhu Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an10.89:14.2: ‘kīva dīghaṃ nu kho bhante padumaniraye āyuppamāṇan' ti?
an10.89:14.5: "ettakāni vassānī" ti iti vā "ettakāni vassasatānī" ti iti vā "ettakāni vassasahassānī" ti iti vā "ettakāni vassasatasahassānī" ti iti vā' ti.
an10.89:15.3: Seyyathā pi bhikkhu vīsatikhāriko Kosalako tilavāho, tato puriso vassasatassa vassasatassa accayena ekam ekaṃ tilaṃ uddhareyya.
an10.89:15.4: Khippataraṃ kho so bhikkhu vīsatikhāriko Kosalako tilavāho iminā upakkamena parikkhayaṃ pariyādānaṃ gaccheyya, na tveva eko abbudo nirayo.
an10.89:15.5: Seyyathā pi bhikkhu vīsati abbudā nirayā, evam eko nirabbudo nirayo.
an10.89:15.6: Seyyathā pi bhikkhu vīsati nirabbudā nirayā, evam eko ababo nirayo.
an10.89:15.7: Seyyathā pi bhikkhu vīsati ababā nirayā, evam eko ahaho nirayo. Seyyathā pi bhikkhu vīsati ahahā nirayā, evam eko aṭaṭo nirayo.
an10.89:15.8: Seyyathā pi bhikkhu vīsati aṭaṭā nirayā,
an10.89:15.10: Seyyathā pi bhikkhu vīsati kumudā nirayā, evam eko sogandhiko nirayo.
an10.89:15.11: Seyyathā pi bhikkhu vīsati sogandhikā nirayā, evam eko uppalako nirayo.
an10.89:15.12: Seyyathā pi bhikkhu uppalakā nirayā, evam eko puṇḍarīko nirayo.
an10.89:15.13: Seyyathā pi bhikkhu vīsati puṇḍarīkā nirayā, evam eko padumo nirayo.
an10.89:15.14: Padumaṃ kho pana bhikkhu nirayaṃ Kokāliko bhikkhu upapanno Sāriputta-Moggallānesu cittaṃ āghātetvā ti.
an10.89:15.16: idaṃ vatvāna Sugato athāparaṃ etad avoca Satthā:
